text.text: Flexibility Virtualized architecture — selection of mobile function in software, not coupled to hardware Fully distributed system resources for optimal performance & maximum capital efficiency Cross-platform services consistency enabled by Star OS (same OS as ASR 5000) Seamless evolution to LTE/4G from 3G (GGSN + PGW & SGW simultaneously) Intelligence Real-time ubiquitous awareness of subscriber, application and network Integrated intelligence yields a 30-40% OPEX reduction (versus external elements) Foundational element of MonArch, Cisco’s monetization architecture that spans the entire infrastructure (client, cloud, and network) Scale First Terabyte-designed platform — 500 Gbps forwarding capacity, 10M sessions, 30M Bearers, and 200K transactions/sec Holistic performance — Throughput + Sessions+ Bearers + Transactions

text.text: The FSC provides switching bandwidth via crossbar switch fabrics and data storage via solid-state persistent hard drives. Each FSC provides six physical fabric planes and adds to the available bandwidth to each card A physical fabric plane provides full-mesh connectivity between all traffic sources Each FSC provides two 2.5'' serial access SCSI (SAS) solid state drives (SSDs) Three FSCs provide sufficient bandwidth; fourth FSC supports redundancy Dimensions – 9.75'' H (50.2 cm) x 1.75'' W (4.44 cm) x 6.75'' D (17.1 cm) Weight – 6 lbs (2.7 kg) Power – 100 watts

text.text: The chassis accepts up to eight 80-amp, -48 VDC power feeds across two redundant power filter units (PFUs). Power Filter Unit A (PFU-A) Power Filter Unit A (PFU-B) The front-mounted PFUs incorporate separate circuit breakers for each power feed, and power connections are made at the top-rear location of the chassis. Dimensions – 3.5'' H (8.9 cm) x 8.5'' W (21.6 cm) x 21.5'' D (54.6 cm) Weight - 15 lbs (6.8 kg)

text.text: The Fan Trays are responsible for moving air through the chassis in order to maintain proper operational temperature. Two fan trays are housed in the front of the chassis: upper front fan tray and lower front fan tray. Air flow complies with Telcordia recommendations to ensure vertical convection cooling Dimensions - 1.625'' H (4.13 cm) x 16.37'' D (41.6 cm) x 5.625'' D (14.3 cm) Weight - 5.5 lbs (2.5 kg) Typical power - 60 watts each (2 per chassis)

text.text: Unmatched Flexibility Virtualized architecture facilitates the selection of mobile function based on software that is not coupled to hardware (flexibility to support multiple functions simultaneously). All system resources are fully distributed, optimizing performance & maximizing capital efficiency Leverages same OS as the ASR 5000 (Star OS) — enables consistent services across platforms Seamless evolution to LTE/4G from 3G and even 2G- same platform that provides the GGSN can also provide PGW and SGW (simultaneously if need be)
